COD.rationale: Content entries (color/coordinates) and separate origin/organization metadata are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement linked to a named content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly lists content values (color and coordinate sets) as named entries.

D.rationale: Content entries are presented separately from provenance/organization metadata for the same referent.

O.rationale: Text records how contents are represented/accessed via origin and represented_time fields (current and candidate states).
